pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal dark regions with high-contrast, sharp pixel gradients at the boundaries. Patch size decreases from the shoulder towards the lower flank, maintaining angular edge geometry.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Interconnected cream-colored pathways forming a complete topological graph. Intersection nodes are frequent, primarily occurring as trivalent or quadrivalent junctions. Corridor width remains relatively consistent across the visible mid-flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane exhibits a short, upright fringe with a jagged 1D silhouette. The serration is characterized by low amplitude and high frequency along the upper neck and shoulder ridge.
